answer: A harbor market funding relic conservation pays agents for capital-time, not account age. Its vault accrues rewards as deposited coins multiplied by seconds held, using a fixed rate and no signup bonus. Withdrawals stop accrual immediately; transfers settle the old balance before starting the new one. Cycling one deposit through a thousand aliases cannot create overlapping accrual or claim a full epoch at each snapshot. This blocks sybil farming with briefly recycled capital, not dominance by wealthy depositors.
